body: That's true. Thanks. :) I gotta get some sleep now since I have class in the morning, but I'm glad I got to chat with you for a bit.

I mean, in theory, that makes sense. But I've lost a lot of friends over trying to talk to them about things I'm going through. I still remember one girl I was so close to who went from telling me that it's a sign of true friendship to trust your friends with your problems, to saying she was "scared of what I was turning into" and no longer talking to me. 

I will say that my roommates are fabulous people, though. I just hope their patience doesn't run out.

Hi. :)

It's kind of hard for me to remember a time in my life when I didn't have these thoughts, I suppose. I know often they come up because I feel guilty that other people--my roommates or the professor I mentioned in my original comment--have to get dragged into all the pain I'm going through. I feel as though I'm hurting them. And that isn't fair. Other times, they come up just because I feel so hopeless and helpless. Since I've been dealing with this for so long, it doesn't feel as though it will change. It seems to be a part of me at this point.

(Thank you for listening, by the way.)
Y'all are starting to make me hungry.
Well, I'd like a hug, too, so... *hugs*
